tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Search SaaS/AI tools by name or category in the MRR Bench index (4,164 tools with verified pricing).

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: All pricing tiers for one tool, with the verbatim pricing-page evidence behind each price and the date it was checked.

tools.name: price_changes
tools.description: Verified list-price changes. Use it to answer 'did X raise its price' with dates and percentages.

tools.name: stack_cost
tools.description: Total monthly and yearly cost of a set of tools, using the cheapest paid monthly-equivalent tier of each. Useful for 'what would this stack cost' questions.
